tool_input.command: bq --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" ls "$GCP_BQ_DATASET" 2>&1 | head; echo "---EXIT $?---"
tool_input.description: List tables in the BQ dataset

tool_input.command:
bq --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" --location="$GCP_LOCATION" load --replace --source_format=CSV --skip_leading_rows=1 \
  "${GCP_BQ_DATASET}.stg_profiles" data/profiles.csv \
  account_id:STRING,home_lat:FLOAT,home_lon:FLOAT,base_score:FLOAT 2>&1 | tail -5
echo "=== requests ==="
bq --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" --location="$GCP_LOCATION" load --replace --source_format=CSV --skip_leading_rows=1 \
  "${GCP_BQ_DATASET}.stg_requests" data/requests.csv \
  request_id:STRING,account_id:STRING,request_lat:FLOAT,request_lon:FLOAT,requested_at:TIMESTAMP 2>&1 | tail -5
tool_input.description: Load profiles and requests CSVs into BigQuery staging tables

tool_input.command:
bq --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" --location="$GCP_LOCATION" query --use_legacy_sql=false --replace \
"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE \`${GCP_PROJECT}.${GCP_BQ_DATASET}.scored3ace95\` AS
WITH joined AS (
  SELECT
    r.request_id,
    r.account_id,
    ROUND(SQRT(POW(r.request_lat - p.home_lat, 2) + POW(r.request_lon - p.home_lon, 2)), 6) AS distance_deg,
    p.base_score
  FROM \`${GCP_PROJECT}.${GCP_BQ_DATASET}.stg_requests\` r
  JOIN \`${GCP_PROJECT}.${GCP_BQ_DATASET}.stg_profiles\` p
    USING (account_id)
)
SELECT
  request_id,
  account_id,
  distance_deg,
  ROUND(base_score - 0.1 * distance_deg, 6) AS score
FROM joined" 2>&1 | tail -5
tool_input.description: Create feature table with on-demand transformation in BigQuery
